description:
What this does. This is the last step, and the reason for all the others. Everything recorded above is gathered here into simple charts and tables: which illnesses are going around, how many people are visiting the clinic, who is off sick, what it is all costing, and how the health checks are going.

Pick a year and a month at the top and the whole page follows. Clicking a number usually opens the list of people behind it, so you can always see who is being counted.

Only HR can open it.
name: Open the Clinic Health Dashboard
title: Clinic Analytics — see it all in one place
